title: Junie — Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: IDE · CLI · Headless CI/CD · GitHub · GitLab

rows.label: What it is
rows.value: Coding agent for delegated engineering work — not just chat. Runs in IDE, CLI, or headless CI/CD.

rows.label: Install (macOS/Linux)
rows.value: curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash

rows.label: Install (Windows)
rows.value: iex (irm 'https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.ps1') in PowerShell

rows.label: Install (npm)
rows.value: npm install -g @jetbrains/junie

rows.label: Install (Homebrew)
rows.value: brew install jetbrains/junie/junie

rows.label: Launch
rows.value: Run junie from your project root to open the interactive TUI.

rows.label: Auth options
rows.value: JetBrains account, JUNIE_API_KEY (usage-based), or BYOK provider keys.

rows.label: Verify version
rows.value: junie --version

rows.label: Plan Mode
rows.value: Read-only analysis → structured design doc before any edit. Toggle with Shift+Tab or /plan.

rows.label: Debug Mode
rows.value: Live IDE debugger integration via /debug; breakpoints, state inspection, expression eval. Requires IDE connection.

rows.label: Hooks (EAP)
rows.value: Shell commands on lifecycle events (SessionStart, PreToolUse, Stop, etc.) via ~/.junie/config.json.

rows.label: Git Worktrees
rows.value: Isolate parallel sessions to separate checkouts with /worktree.

rows.label: Remote Mode
rows.value: Stream a running CLI session to the Junie web app via /remote.

rows.label: Brave Mode
rows.value: Three-level approval control (Off / Auto / On) via /brave or Ctrl+B.

rows.label: Model & Effort
rows.value: Select LLM and reasoning effort per session with /model and /effort.

rows.label: ACP support
rows.value: Run as an Agent Client Protocol server with junie --acp true for editor integrations.

rows.label: Agent loop
rows.value: prompt → plan → multi-file edits → commands → verification → summary. Delegate work you want executed.

rows.label: Good task shape
rows.value: Bounded, testable goal with clear acceptance criteria. Avoid open-ended or exploratory requests.

rows.label: @-attach context
rows.value: Type @ in the prompt to attach specific files or folders — attach the smallest useful context.

rows.label: Image inputs
rows.value: Drag-and-drop or reference screenshots/design specs; Junie reads PNG, JPEG, and other common formats.

rows.label: Real-time follow-ups
rows.value: Type clarifications while Junie is working; they are appended to the running prompt immediately.

rows.label: Rollback
rows.value: In IDE plugin Done panel, review changed files and revert selectively before accepting results.

rows.label: Shell passthrough
rows.value: Prefix any shell command with ! to run it without leaving the TUI, e.g. !git status.

rows.label: .junie/ dir
rows.value: Root of project-scoped Junie config: guidelines, MCP servers, agents, plans, extensions.

rows.label: AGENTS.md
rows.value: .junie/AGENTS.md — primary guidelines file, version-controlled, loaded for every task.

rows.label: Fallback chain
rows.value: Custom path → .junie/AGENTS.md → root AGENTS.md + .junie/playbook.md + .junie/rules/*.md.

rows.label: Override path
rows.value: Set a custom guidelines path in IDE: Settings | Tools | Junie | Project Settings.

rows.label: config.json (user)
rows.value: ~/.junie/config.json — personal defaults: model, effort, provider, brave, hooks, MCP locations.

rows.label: config.json (project)
rows.value: <root>/.junie/config.json — shared team defaults; hooks from this file are ignored by default for safety.

rows.label: Extra configs
rows.value: --config-location /path/config.json loads additional files; overrides default locations.

rows.label: .aiignore
rows.value: List files/folders Junie must seek explicit approval before reading or editing (gitignore syntax).

rows.label: Multi-file edits
rows.value: Junie creates and edits files across the project in a single session without manual switching.

rows.label: Runs commands
rows.value: Executes build/test/lint commands; sensitive actions require approval or Allowlist entry.

rows.label: Verification
rows.value: Runs your test suite and inspection tools to confirm the change before submitting.

rows.label: IDE-backed search
rows.value: When IDE is connected, @ completions include symbols and classes from the IDE index.

rows.label: Code Mode (IDE)
rows.value: Breaks task into plan, executes autonomously, reports progress; offers follow-up or rollback at Done.

rows.label: Ask Mode (IDE)
rows.value: Read-only exploration: no file modifications, useful for understanding codebase or brainstorming.

rows.label: Subagents
rows.value: Main agent auto-delegates to matching .junie/agents/*.md subagents for focused subtasks.
Type / in the prompt to browse and invoke all available slash commands.
Type ? to list all keyboard shortcuts available in the current TUI context.

rows.label: Ctrl+R
rows.value: Search prompt history across all sessions; navigate results with arrow keys.

rows.label: /account
rows.value: Manage credentials: JetBrains account, Junie API key, BYOK keys, custom model endpoints.

rows.label: /usage
rows.value: Show token cost breakdown, models used, and remaining balance for the current session.

rows.label: /extensions
rows.value: Browse, install, update, and remove extension bundles (skills, MCP, commands, hooks). Alias: /plugins.

rows.label: /mcp
rows.value: List configured MCP servers with status; Ctrl+A opens the MCP Installation Assistant.

rows.label: /settings
rows.value: Open persistent settings including transcript display mode and subagent model policy.

rows.label: Toggle
rows.value: Shift+Tab cycles default → Plan → Debug. Or type /plan to toggle Plan Mode.

rows.label: /plan <prompt>
rows.value: Enables Plan Mode and submits the prompt immediately, e.g. /plan refactor commands.

rows.label: --plan flag
rows.value: junie --plan or junie --prompt "…" --plan starts directly in Plan Mode.

rows.label: Plan behavior
rows.value: Read-only exploration of codebase; produces structured design doc (Requirements, Tech Design, Testing, Steps).

rows.label: Ctrl+P
rows.value: Open dedicated plan view with tabbed sections at any time during a plan-mode session.

rows.label: Confirm & implement
rows.value: Accept the plan to start implementation; iterate as many times as needed before confirming.

rows.label: Save the plan
rows.value: Choose Save the plan and stop to keep the Markdown plan file without implementing.

rows.label: Scope
rows.value: Plan Mode applies to the next submitted prompt only; re-enable for subsequent planning prompts.

rows.label: Launch in IDE
rows.value: Open AI Chat tool window; select Junie by JetBrains from the coding agents list.

rows.label: Plugin install
rows.value: Search JetBrains Junie in Marketplace (Ctrl+Alt+S → Plugins), or install the 26104 plugin manually.

rows.label: Min IDE version
rows.value: IntelliJ/PyCharm/WebStorm/GoLand: 2024.3.2+; others: 2025.1+; CLion/Rider: 2025.2.1+.

rows.label: Mode picker
rows.value: Use the dropdown in the prompt window to switch between Code, Ask, or Auto mode.

rows.label: Diff viewer
rows.value: Click file links in the task output to open inline diffs for each changed file.

rows.label: Open terminal
rows.value: Click the terminal icon in Junie's tool window to see CLI command output or supply user input.

rows.label: Trial
rows.value: Start a 30-day AI Pro trial from the Junie tool window; no paid plan required to begin.

rows.label: /review
rows.value: Local code review wizard: choose From Main, Last Commit, or Unstaged Changes.

rows.label: Custom scope
rows.value: /review focusing on performance and memory leaks — append plain-text instructions.

rows.label: [CRITICAL]
rows.value: Security vulnerabilities, crashes, data loss findings are prefixed [CRITICAL] with ready-to-apply suggestions.

rows.label: Accept/dismiss
rows.value: Browse findings grouped by file; accept or dismiss suggestions individually or in bulk.

rows.label: --review flag
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" --review runs headless review; optionally add a natural-language scope.

rows.label: Review session
rows.value: Review runs as its own resumable session — ask follow-ups without re-explaining context.

rows.label: Human approval
rows.value: Always keep humans in the PR/MR approval path; Junie review is a complement, not a gate.

rows.label: /model
rows.value: Interactive model picker; Default is dynamically set to best price-quality ratio.

rows.label: /effort
rows.value: Change reasoning effort for current model: minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

rows.label: JUNIE_API_KEY
rows.value: Usage-based auth token; generate at junie.jetbrains.com/cli. Pass via --auth in headless mode.

rows.label: BYOK
rows.value: Add keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, OpenRouter, or Copilot via /account or config.json byok field.

rows.label: Model aliases
rows.value: sonnet, opus, gpt, gpt-codex, gemini-pro, gemini-flash, grok map to JetBrains-curated versions.

rows.label: JUNIE_MODEL
rows.value: Env var to set default model; equivalent CLI flag: --model.

rows.label: JUNIE_EFFORT
rows.value: Env var to set default effort level; equivalent CLI flag: --effort.

rows.label: Helper model
rows.value: Junie auto-selects a secondary model for routing/summarization from the same provider — expected behavior.

rows.label: mcp.json (project)
rows.value: .junie/mcp/mcp.json — commit to VCS to share MCP config with teammates.

rows.label: mcp.json (user)
rows.value: ~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json — personal MCP servers available across all projects.

rows.label: Add server
rows.value: Run /mcp → press Ctrl+A for the MCP Installation Assistant; guides setup including OAuth.

rows.label: Approvals
rows.value: MCP tool calls are sensitive actions requiring user approval unless added to the Action Allowlist.

rows.label: Extensions marketplace
rows.value: Install extension bundles that package MCP servers + skills via /extensions; scoped per-project or per-user.

rows.label: Tool limit
rows.value: Junie supports a maximum of 100 tools across all configured MCP servers.

rows.label: --mcp-location
rows.value: Point Junie at extra MCP config folders; use --mcp-default-locations false to disable defaults.

rows.label: Basic usage
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" "Fix any failing tests" — positional arg is the prompt.

rows.label: --review flag
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" --review runs automated code review of current changes.

rows.label: --plan flag
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" --plan "…" produces a plan document without implementing.

rows.label: --model / --provider
rows.value: Override LLM and BYOK provider per run; also accept JUNIE_MODEL / JUNIE_LLM_PROVIDER env vars.

rows.label: Project trust
rows.value: Non-interactive runs are trusted by design; they load project config (MCP, hooks, agents) without prompting.

rows.label: CI install one-liner
rows.value: Add curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash as a CI step before invoking junie.

rows.label: --help
rows.value: Prints the full list of CLI flags and environment variables.

rows.label: Action ref
rows.value: JetBrains/junie-github-action@v1 — runs entirely on your GitHub runners.

rows.label: @junie-agent
rows.value: Mention @junie-agent in an issue or PR comment to trigger a Junie run.

rows.label: Required secret
rows.value: Add JUNIE_API_KEY to repository Secrets; or use BYOK keys (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, etc.).

rows.label: Permissions
rows.value: Workflow needs contents: write, pull-requests: write, issues: write.

rows.label: trigger_phrase
rows.value: Input to change activation keyword from the default @junie-agent.

rows.label: MCP servers
rows.value: allowed_mcp_servers: "mcp_github_checks_server"; inline comment server auto-enabled on PRs.

rows.label: Output: pr_url
rows.value: Step output steps.junie.outputs.pr_url contains the URL of the created pull request.

rows.label: silent_mode
rows.value: Set silent_mode: true for dry runs — no commits, branches, PRs, or comments are created.

rows.label: #junie trigger
rows.value: Tag #junie in an issue or MR comment to invoke the agent pipeline.

rows.label: MR reviews
rows.value: Junie auto-reviews any opened MR; tag #junie code-review in a comment for on-demand review.

rows.label: GITLAB_TOKEN_FOR_JUNIE
rows.value: GitLab access token (Maintainer role, api scope) stored in the Junie container project's CI variables.

rows.label: JUNIE_API_KEY (GitLab)
rows.value: Set in the Junie container project's CI/CD variables; BYOK alternatives: JUNIE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, etc.

rows.label: Container project
rows.value: Create a dedicated GitLab project for Junie pipelines; one per GitLab instance.

rows.label: Init pipeline
rows.value: Run the init pipeline with PROJECTS_TO_INIT variable to set up webhooks and access tokens.

rows.label: Iterate on MRs
rows.value: Tag #junie in an MR comment with follow-up instructions to refine the submitted MR.

rows.label: Supported IDEs
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, RubyMine, RustRover, CLion, Rider, Android Studio.

rows.label: /ide
rows.value: Inspect IDE connection state, switch between running IDEs, install plugin if missing.

rows.label: IDE states
rows.value: Connected · Connecting… · Auth required · Missing · Unsupported · Not responding.

rows.label: Unsupported version
rows.value: Unsupported means IDE version is older than 2026.1 — update the IDE.

rows.label: /debug
rows.value: Switch CLI to Debug Mode: set breakpoints, inspect variables, evaluate expressions against live IDE debugger.

rows.label: IDE benefits
rows.value: Symbol-aware search, code inspections, test discovery, and project-aware refactoring via IDE index.

rows.label: Log path
rows.value: ~/.junie/logs/junie.log — check here for connection errors if /ide shows Error or Auth required.

rows.label: /new
rows.value: Start another live session; current session keeps running in the background.

rows.label: /new <prompt>
rows.value: Open a new session with the prompt pre-filled, e.g. /new update tests for payment flow.

rows.label: /history
rows.value: Open Task history to search, switch live sessions, or resume saved sessions from past runs.

rows.label: Ctrl+O
rows.value: Open continuously-updated transcript.md for the current session (or built-in Transcript view).

rows.label: /worktree
rows.value: Switch to or create a Git worktree; isolates file changes for parallel sessions.

rows.label: /remote
rows.value: Stream the running CLI session to junie.jetbrains.com/remote for web access from any device.

rows.label: Cross-process sessions
rows.value: Sessions open in another Junie instance appear dimmed in /history and cannot be taken over.

rows.label: Action Allowlist
rows.value: Saved in ~/.junie/allowlist.json; add entries during a run via → Always allow, or edit manually.

rows.label: Approval model
rows.value: Terminal commands, file edits outside project, MCP tool calls all require explicit approval by default.

rows.label: Brave Mode levels
rows.value: Off: ask for every sensitive action. Auto: classify & auto-approve safe commands. On: no approvals.

rows.label: Hooks safety
rows.value: Project .junie/config.json hooks are ignored by default; pass hook files via --config-location explicitly.

rows.label: Project trust
rows.value: Untrusted projects skip MCP, hooks, agents, guidelines; use isolated temp Junie storage.

rows.label: Trust storage
rows.value: Markers stored under ~/.junie/trust; delete exact marker to revoke a project's trust.

rows.label: BYOK privacy
rows.value: BYOK requests go directly to the provider; not routed through JetBrains AI service.

rows.label: PermissionRequest hook
rows.value: Auto-allow or deny permission dialogs programmatically via hook matched on tool name (e.g. Bash).

rows.label: Start bounded
rows.value: Prefer small, testable tasks over large open-ended requests; easier to verify and rollback.

rows.label: Plan complex work
rows.value: Use Plan Mode for non-trivial tasks — adjusting a plan is far cheaper than reverting bad edits.

rows.label: Explicit validation
rows.value: Tell Junie exactly which test command to run and what passing output looks like.

rows.label: Context discipline
rows.value: Attach the smallest file/folder set that covers the task; large context slows the agent and costs more.

rows.label: Version-sensitive CI
rows.value: Pin JetBrains/junie-github-action@v1.x.x in production workflows; @main is for dev only.

rows.label: Worktrees for parallel work
rows.value: Pre-create Git worktrees before parallel tasks so build caches are warm when sessions start.

rows.label: Effort default
rows.value: Keep default effort; higher effort costs more & isn't always better — only raise it for specific tasks.

rows.label: Demo artifacts
rows.value: After /demo, find report.html, demo.mp4, and screenshots at ~/.junie/sessions/<id>/demo/.
